description: This file declares the WaylandServer class, which implements a Wayland compositing server interface for receiving frame updates from clients. It includes class constructors, destructors, callback registration methods, and internal state management.

classes.name: wayland::WaylandServer
classes.description: A class representing a Wayland compositing server that manages client connections, frame updates, and internal server state.

methods.name: WaylandServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Wayland server, optionally with a socket file descriptor and frame format flag.

methods.name: ~WaylandServer
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up server resources.

methods.name: SetFrameCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when a new frame is available.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for display events.

methods.name: ServerLoop
methods.description: Internal method running the server loop, handling socket communication and frame updates.
